children: launched product deliveries within an hour in Brazil, starting in the city of Sao Paulo, Fernando Yunes, the firm's executive vice president of commerce, said on Thursday.

The Latin American e-commerce and fintech company also will expand its pharmacy business in the country, with its own pharmacy in Sao Paulo beginning to sell prescription products  this month, Yunes said at a company event.
MercadoLibre will add third-party pharmacies to its e-commerce platform in Brazil as of October, kicking off in Sao Paulo with three drugstore chains, which were not named.
The company expects to have 20 third-party physical drugstore locations in Sao Paulo on its platform by the end of the year.
The one-hour service, which started as a test in an undisclosed region of Sao Paulo and is expected to be expanded, will include products such as medications,  food and others.
